LanguageData.CC_Making_Sub: From the benches you have and what's in stock, read from every bench's own recipes.
LanguageData.CC_Making_HeaderTip: Once an hour, or when you ask, the council reads the recipes of every bench the colony has and checks them against the stock: what a batch could be made of now with no bill set for it (what the building and the bills wait on first, then the staples, and of clothes and weapons only the dearest), the chains (a material the blueprints are short of or a bill waits on, and the bench here that makes it, with a bill sized to the want), the bills waiting on an ingredient the colony has none of, the harvests and finds no bench here puts to its own use and which bench would, and the benches standing without bills. A product the colony already has sixty or more of isn't suggested unless something waits on it. Any mod's benches and recipes count by themselves. The automations in the settings can set these bills for you.
LanguageData.CC_Making_CouldNone: Nothing new: every batch the stock allows has a bill already, or the colony has plenty of it.
LanguageData.CC_Making_SetBillTip: Adds a bill to the {0}: make until the colony has that many, then rest. Change or remove it on the bench like any other.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chains: Wanted for the building and the bills
LanguageData.CC_Making_WantedBuild: The blueprints are {0} short of it.
LanguageData.CC_Making_WantedBill: A bill on the {0} waits on it.
LanguageData.CC_Making_CantMake: Its own parts are short: {PARTS} (have/need for one batch).
LanguageData.CC_Making_Starved: Waiting on {0}, and the colony has none.
LanguageData.CC_Making_StarvedNoFix: No bench here makes it: grow it, mine it, trade for it, or change the bill's ingredients.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_Rates: Uses {USE} a day, makes {MAKE} a day: {DAYS}.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_Batch: A batch of {N} takes {H} hours at the {BENCH}, from {PARTS} (have/need).
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_Lead: The whole chain, batch by batch: about {0} days.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_Cycle: It takes itself to make: the chain stops here.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_Deep: Four links down: the chain stops here.
LanguageData.CC_Making_ZoneGrows: A zone of {N} cell(s) grows {PLANT} already.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Chain_SetAllTip: A bill on each bench down the chain, the parts' first, each to make until the colony has what the next link takes and three days of its use.
LanguageData.CC_Making_ChainSet: The chain's bills are set for {PRODUCT}: {N} bill(s).
LanguageData.CC_Making_SowTip: Adds that many cells beside the zone that grows it, or lays out a new growing zone near the fields, on fertile, open ground it can grow on. An ordinary zone afterwards.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Sown: A growing zone of {N} cell(s) of {PLANT} is laid out, for {PRODUCT}.
LanguageData.CC_Making_NoGround: No open, fertile ground near the fields for {0}.
LanguageData.CC_Making_Unused: Harvests and finds nothing here uses
LanguageData.CC_Making_UnusedNone: Everything the colony has a fair amount of has a bench here that puts it to use.
LanguageData.CC_Making_WouldUse_Built: The {BENCH} you have would make {PRODUCT} from it, once it can.
LanguageData.CC_Making_IdleLine: {0}. A bench with no bills makes nothing; the lines above say what each could be set to.
